parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: Page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of applications displayed per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: SortType
parameters.description:
Sorting method. Valid values:

- 0: Ascending order by time.
- 1: Descending order by time.
